items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. It includes CVE-2026-103849 (Improper Neutralization of Special Elements), CVE-2026-92909 (Incorrect Authorization), and several XSS vulnerabilities.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (CVE-2026-75650) under active attack
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system, and it has been actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical flaw, rated CVSS 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation. It includes CVE-2026-76200 (Cross-site Scripting), CVE-2026-77111 (Incorrect Authorization), and CVE-2026-77108 (Path Traversal).

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: This bulletin addresses seven vulnerabilities, including a critical one (CVE-2026-71362) that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges, with indications of active exploitation. The critical vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB25-71
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe was not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this update.

items.title: CVE-2026-48358: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: This is an RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by improper encoding, enabling arbitrary code execution without user interaction or authentication. Successful exploitation can lead to full storefront compromise, payment data theft, and lateral movement.
